previous_assumption: Platform Admin backend (cross-tenant organizations/users/catalogue administration) could not be safely scoped without its own reviewed architecture decision, since organizationTypeCodeSchema is a locked two-value enum and there is no authorization tier above Rental Company/Renter.
correction: Business validated Platform Admin is required (catalogue administration + org/user suspend + read-only cross-tenant requirement/auction oversight). Implemented as a wholly separate staff_users/staff_sessions principal, reusing the exact same password-hashing (scrypt) and session-token discipline as tenant auth but its own login endpoint (/admin/auth/login) and its own cookie (fleetip_staff_session). Deliberately does NOT add a third organization type — organizationTypeCodeSchema stays locked to rental_company/renter, keeping it clean for real future tenant types (Transport, OEM) without ever conflating them with FleetIP's own staff. organizations.status/users.status back suspend/reactivate, enforced at the two real choke points (PermissionService.hasPermission and AuthService.login, the latter checked only after a real password match so it cannot be used to enumerate accounts). One fixed staff role for now, no staff_roles/staff_permissions table. Verified live end-to-end: org suspension actually blocks and restores tenant API access; user suspension actually blocks and restores login.
